note: The nested Object body `b. ` has no separator at all: a `.` arms a dotted-key segment start, then only whitespace follows to end of body. Missing separator inside a closed compound is § 6.12, not EmptyKey (which needs an actual separator with an empty final dotted segment, e.g. `a.: 1`). A quote in the unrelated sibling `q` must not change this category.
